```sql
SELECT SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_orders
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM placed_at) = 2025;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    region,
    SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders
WHERE 
    order_date_local >= '2027-01-01' 
    AND order_date_local < '2027-04-01'
GROUP BY 
    region
ORDER BY 
    net_revenue DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    c.region,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS new_customers_gained
FROM 
    analytics.dim_customers c
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_date d ON c.signed_up_at::DATE = d.date_day
WHERE 
    d.calendar_year = 2025
    AND c.first_order_on IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    c.region
ORDER BY 
    new_customers_gained DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    SUM(fct_orders.net_revenue_eur) / NULLIF(SUM(m.amount_eur), 0) AS return_on_spend
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders
JOIN 
    analytics.fct_sessions fs ON fct_orders.order_id = fs.converted_order_id
JOIN 
    analytics.fct_refunds fr ON fct_orders.order_id = fr.order_id
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_date d ON fct_orders.placed_at::DATE = d.date_day
JOIN 
    raw.marketing_spend m ON d.date_day = m.spend_date
WHERE 
    m.channel = 'paid_search'
    AND d.date_day >= '2025-01-01'
    AND d.date_day < '2026-01-01';
```
